name: MCP Server
description: Lets AI tools use the open project through the Model Context Protocol. One server; every extension brings its own tools.

services.description: How AI tools change a project: undoable, and refused while anything is unsaved.

mcp.enabled.description: Serve the MCP tools to AI clients on this computer. Clients start `w3proj mcp`, which connects to this app.

mcp.projectTools.description: Also offer tools from the open project's own extensions (.w3proj/extensions). A map you got from someone else could bring any tool.

mcp.writeTools.description: Also offer tools that change things. All built-in tools only read so far.

mcpTools.name: list_edits
mcpTools.description: The AI edits made to this project since it was opened, oldest first.

mcpTools.name: undo_last_edit
mcpTools.description: Takes back the newest AI edit, unless its files changed since. Can be repeated. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools.

mcpTools.name: edit_text_file
mcpTools.description: Replaces one exact piece of a text file under map/, such as war3map.wts. The piece must occur exactly once. Prefer the specific tools: map/war3map.j is rebuilt from triggers and objects, so changes to it can be lost. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

find.description: The text to replace, with enough around it to be unique.

mcpTools.name: project_info
mcpTools.description: The open map project: name, folder, number of files, the file open in the editor.

mcpTools.name: list_files
mcpTools.description: Files of the open project, with sizes.

filter.description: Only paths containing this text (not case sensitive).

mcpTools.name: read_file
mcpTools.description: A text file of the open project, such as map/war3map.j or map/war3map.w3i.json.

path.description: Project-relative path, as list_files gives it.

offset.description: Start at this character (for files too long for one read).
